collegeFullAddress: H. R. Mahajani Marg, Matunga, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400019
collegeInfo: Established in 1887, VJTI Mumbai is one of Asia’s oldest technical institutes. It offers B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, and Ph.D. courses and is renowned for its rigorous curriculum, top placements, and vibrant student life. The 16-acre Matunga campus features modern research labs, central library, sports complex, and innovation centers.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Reserved category, EWS, minority, and economically weaker section students as per Maharashtra norms.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply via MahaDBT portal with documents.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Top-performing students in academics (from 2nd year onward) with demonstrated financial need.
Offered by industry partners and VJTI alumni for select branches and meritorious performance.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply via institution/department or as per sponsor notification.

events.eventFullDescription: Technovanza, VJTI’s flagship techfest, is one of India’s largest student-run engineering festivals, featuring competitions in robotics, coding, bridge building, automation, workshops, guest lectures, and entertainment nights.
Pratibimb is VJTI's annual cultural fest which includes dance, drama, music, literature, and fine arts competitions, along with celebrity nights and workshops.
Enthusia is the intercollegiate sports fest of VJTI, with cricket, football, athletics, chess, table tennis, badminton, basketball, and more, attracting thousands of participants across Mumbai.
X-Cell hosts VJTI’s entrepreneurship and innovation conclave, with hackathons, idea pitching, guest lectures, B-plan contests, and mentorship for start-ups.

importantDates.event: B.Tech Admissions 2025 (via MHT-CET & DTE CAP rounds)

infrastructure.infraDescription: The 16-acre campus includes historic academic buildings, digital library, 100+ research labs, 8 boys' and 2 girls' hostels, sports complex with grounds and courts, auditorium, startups and innovation cell, 24x7 Wi-Fi, canteen, medical center, and extensive student activity spaces.

universityAffiliatedTo: Autonomous Institute (affiliated with University of Mumbai)
